Nuevo Laredo's city council has named Alma Sánchez Lerma as the city's new Secretary of Public Works and Urban Development, according to CML Noticias.

The council approved the appointment by majority vote during its 69th Ordinary Session, where Sánchez Lerma took the oath of office to assume the post.

Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal stressed during the session the importance of coordination and commitment within the work team, so infrastructure projects can continue and residents' needs can be met, according to CML Noticias.

Sánchez Lerma brings experience in works supervision, estimate control, and infrastructure project development in both the municipal and private sectors, as well as participation in the education sector, according to the report.

Before the appointment, she served as a council member and chaired the Human Settlements and Public Works Commission, where she followed infrastructure projects and urban development matters. She was also the first woman to preside over the Nuevo Laredo College of Civil Engineers.

With the appointment, the municipal administration plans to continue planning, executing, and supervising public works, along with urban development projects aimed at meeting the needs of Nuevo Laredo families, according to CML Noticias.

Sources:

  • CML Noticias, "Designa Cabildo a Alma Sánchez Lerma como secretaria de Obras Públicas en Nuevo Laredo," October 26, 2026
  • El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, "De regidora a titular de Obras Públicas; Alma Sánchez Lerma asume la Secretaría de Obras Públicas," October 26, 2026
